tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Which languages does Zofia speak?"
B builds the answer from the tiles. Put the blue verb into the right form. The two parts of the pair go together: both ... and, either ... or, neither ... nor, not only ... but also.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Swap cards and do it all again, faster.
